what: The dressing of Tết (plan 0026, R19). Each count comes from a row of docs/content/culture-notes.md, section "The weeks before Tết, 2018 to 2021", with the same link. All items are Check, and in_game is false: the game does not read this file until the owner confirms each item (report 0026, Q28).
days_note: days: the first and the last day of the game (day 1 is 22 January 2019) on which the item stands. The festival opens on the evening of 27 tháng Chạp (day 11); before that its models are in construction.
